description: Enclosure that holds one OZ510 Receiver and one OZ510 Transmitter side by side, I/O (SMA + pin header) on a common front panel. Behind the modules, a fiber plenum stores each module's SC/APC pigtail; the pigtails plug into panel-mounted SC/APC simplex adapters in the back wall, giving external SC/APC ports. Base tray + removable lid. Modules retained by screws through their existing baseplate mounting holes into standoff bosses.

module._comment: Geometry extracted from the OZ510 Receiver STEP (receiver-handed). Origin: plate centered in X, plate center in Z, plate BOTTOM at Y=0. Front (I/O) at +Z, can points +Y. The TRANSMITTER'S I/O is a MIRROR across X (SMA at +12.70, header on -X) — bays[].mirror_x flips each bay's cutouts accordingly. EXCEPTION: the fiber pigtail exit on the can's BACK is NOT mirrored — both RX and TX exit at module-local x=+7.37 (verified in both vendor STEP analyses), so fiber features use fiber_exit_x directly, never the mirror flag. MOUNTING: the four corner_hole_* holes are OCCUPIED by vendor press-fit PCB standoffs (posts rise ~5mm above the plate and the hardware protrudes 1.5mm BELOW it) — never screw there. The free holes are the three 3.175 (1/8in, M3-clearance) plate holes: a front pair (screw_hole_front is the INNER one; the outer at x=-5.715 sits over the SMA's under-plate body — no boss room) and screw_hole_back on centerline. The front pair IS mirrored on the TX (verified: +1.778/+5.715), so screw bosses are handed via mirror_x; the back hole is mirror-invariant.

fiber_bay._comment: Full-width open-top plenum behind the module bays that stores each pigtail's slack and hosts the back-panel adapter ports. depth must exceed the adapter's inner protrusion + mated_connector_clear (checked in tests). The spool post at the plenum center coils the slack; its radius IS the enforced minimum bend radius (900um buffered fiber: keep >= 15).

sc_adapter._comment: Flanged SC/APC simplex adapter/coupler, dims from the FS.com AD-SCA-SCA-SM-SX-FS datasheet (body 27.4 long, flange 22 x 11.8 x 3 mid-body, body section 12.8 x 9.3, two 2.3 dia screw holes at 18 spacing, M2 screws). The adapter itself is modeled in parts/vendor/sc-apc-simplex-adapter (fit_check mates it into this housing); the mated pigtail connector is parts/vendor/sc-apc-connector. Mounted long-axis HORIZONTAL through the back wall, flange proud on the outer face, inserted from outside. Verify against the ordered adapter's datasheet before printing.

notes: Module geometry auto-extracted from the vendor STEP assemblies (parts/vendor/zonu-oz510-*). Verify against a real unit before fabrication.

MOUNTING (v4): two M3x6 screws per module through the free 3.175mm plate holes (front inner + back center) into screw_boss pilots (2.5mm thread-forming, drilled to 0.5mm above the outer floor face for full engagement), plus four pilot-less support studs under bare plate at (±stud_dx, stud_z). The studs are pulled ~6mm inboard from the plate corners because the vendor corner hardware protrudes 1.5mm below the plate there — studs directly under the corners would rock the module. standoff_height (3.0) > pin/hardware drop (max 1.93) so everything under the plate clears the floor.

Both SMA connectors protrude through the front (-Y in the model) panel; each header has a front-panel wiring slot on the opposite side of its bay. With RX left / TX right, the SMAs land on the outboard edges and the headers inboard.
Lid access openings sit directly above each pin-header block so headers can be plugged/unplugged with the lid on.

Layout: side-by-side, I/O on one face. Left bay = Receiver, right bay = Transmitter. NOT interchangeable: the TX is a mirror image of the RX (its SMA/header swap sides), so each bay's cutouts are handed via bays[].mirror_x.

FIBER PATH (v3): each module's factory SC/APC pigtail exits the can's back through a top-open slot in the partition (top-open so a module drops in with its pigtail attached), coils its slack around the central spool, and plugs into the inner side of its bay's back-panel SC/APC adapter. The external fiber run plugs into the adapter from outside.

Adapter install: push the adapter through its cutout from outside and drive two M2 self-tappers through the flange holes into the 1.7mm pilots. The adapter's snap clips stay compressed inside the 3mm wall (they are sized for ~1.9mm panels) — retention comes from the flange screws.

v2 (2026-07-21): fixed the transmitter bay — v1 wrongly assumed the TX was identical to the RX, putting its SMA hole and wiring slot on the mirrored (wrong) side. Caught by visual inspection of the fit renders.

v3 (2026-07-21): added the fiber plenum, partition pass-slots, back-panel SC/APC adapter ports, slack spool, and two back-corner lid posts. The pass-slots are NOT mirrored: both modules' pigtails exit at module-local x=+7.37 (RX at -15.2, TX at +29.9 in housing X — verified per-file in the vendor analyses). Also fixed a v2 lid bug: the registration lip was a single full-interior box that overlapped the central rib and its screw posts, so the lid could not seat; the lip is now one pad per module bay.

v4 (2026-07-21): moved module mounting off the corner holes — they turned out to be OCCUPIED by vendor press-fit standoffs (with 1.5mm under-plate protrusion; v1-v3's screws could never have gone there). Now: two M3 screws per module through the free 1/8in plate holes (front pair is TX-mirrored, back hole on centerline) into 7mm pilot bosses, plus four pilot-less studs shifted inboard to bare plate. Note: an M3 head on the front inner hole slightly overhangs the unused outer hole (~0.4mm) — harmless, or fit a small washer.

v4 also fixed a latent v1-era fit bug the tightened checks exposed: the SMA's square base block extends 1.65mm past the plate front edge (> clearance_end 1.5), so it bore 0.15mm into the front wall — the residual ~5.6mm^3 interference every fit check had shrugged off under its old 25mm^3 threshold. The wall now gets a shallow handed relief pocket around each SMA hole, and the module-fit threshold is 2mm^3.
